card.name: Just before the word Andean or Andhra
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before a place name starting with And, such as Andean, Andes, Andhra Pradesh. It also fires weakly on similar spots in other text.

modes.label: Before Andean/Andes
modes.description: The word right before Andean or Andes in geography or biology text.
modes.example: 67% of European germplasm is<< of>> Andean origin.

modes.label: Before Andhra
modes.description: A word or comma right before Andhra Pradesh in Indian place text.

modes.label: Other scattered spots
modes.description: Odd positions such as a space before a number or the start of a brand name.

card.writes: It seems to promote the word And and its variants, which would continue a name that begins with And.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a name like Andes or Andhra, getting ready for it.
